ppocrv6_medium.name: PP-OCRv6 Medium Multilingual
ppocrv6_medium.notes: Recommended general multilingual Hebrew/Yiddish model; requires Kraken >= 7.1.

vilne_yiddish.name: Vilne Yiddish Hand 1
vilne_yiddish.notes: Interwar Ashkenazi cursive model. Weights are CC BY-NC 4.0.

party_multilingual.name: Party Multilingual Base
party_multilingual.notes: Requires the Party Kraken plugin in addition to Kraken; model is about 518 MB.

biblia.name: BiblIA
biblia.notes: The cited public Zenodo record is a dataset, not a directly downloadable recognition model. Place an obtained BiblIA weight file here manually.

samaritan_hebrew.name: PP-OCRv6 Samaritan Hebrew Medium Fine-tuned
samaritan_hebrew.notes: Experimental comparison only: trained for Samaritan Hebrew, not Ashkenazi cursive.

bohemica.name: Bohemica 19th-century Registers
bohemica.notes: Control experiment only: German/Czech Latin-script model and cannot recognize Hebrew letters.
